intent: Write an SEO brief and a 600-word blog post about choosing a first electric bike.

spec.goal: Get an SEO brief and a roughly 600-word blog post that help readers choose their first electric bike.
spec.deliverable: An SEO brief for the topic of choosing a first electric bike, plus a written blog post of about 600 words on the same topic.
constraints: The blog post is about 600 words long.
The topic of both pieces is choosing a first electric bike.
The blog post is aimed at people buying their first electric bike.
The blog post should follow the SEO brief.
done_criteria: An SEO brief for the topic of choosing a first electric bike is included.
A blog post of approximately 600 words is included.
The blog post focuses on choosing a first electric bike.
The blog post is consistent with the SEO brief.
spec.summary: You want an SEO brief and a roughly 600-word blog post about choosing a first electric bike.
